doc: The full environment for one engine launch, built from its final argv and the

name: preset_device_mismatch
doc: One-line warning text when an operator's preset MTMD_BACKEND_DEVICE names a

name: EngineBudgetInputs
doc: Everything the cap needs, measured by the caller.

name: EngineBudget
doc: The decision, with the reason attached so a log can say which limit applied.

name: effective_engine_cap
doc: TOTAL engines this tag may run, given the measured inputs.

name: context_window_capacity
doc: Total concurrent context windows this tag can serve.

name: name_candidates
doc: Candidate names for one reverse lookup answer, whole name first.

name: confirmed_name
doc: The name to show for ``address``, or ``None`` when no candidate confirms.

name: identity_client_meta
doc: Return the identity keys of ``client_meta`` that are present, and nothing else.

name: parse_census_meta
doc: Rebuild the small metadata dict the census needs from one projected array.

name: strip_stored_meta
doc: Return the identity-only JSON text for a stored slot body, or None when it cannot be reduced.

name: run_once
doc: One bounded run of the retention pass over ended slots. Synchronous; call it off the event loop.

name: maybe_sweep
doc: Run one retention run if the setting is on and the pass is due. Returns its counts, or None.

name: dir_accounting
doc: Return ``(total_bytes, bins)`` for the ``.bin`` files in ``save_dir``.

name: cap_exceeded
doc: True when ``total_bytes`` has reached ``cap_bytes``.

name: SaveGate
doc: The outcome of :func:`enforce_save_cap`, with the numbers a log line needs.

name: enforce_save_cap
doc: Decide whether a save may proceed, driving ``make_room`` once if the cap is reached.

name: ProtectionSplit
doc: The two protection tiers, as sets of thread hashes.

name: split_protection
doc: Build the HARD and SOFT hash sets from ``(thread_id, client_meta, chain)`` triples.

name: soft_age_targets
doc: Bins the age prune may reclaim: the unprotected candidates, then the SOFT-thread bins.

name: soft_ceiling_order
doc: SOFT bins the ceiling prune may take once every unprotected bin has gone, oldest first.

name: drop_stale_pairs
signature: (save_dir, model_tag, thread_hash, new_port, live_turns, landed_bytes, n_written, remove)
doc: Remove the pairs ``thread_hash`` left on ports other than ``new_port``, and report what went.

name: StalePair
doc: One saved bin of the thread on a port it left, and the bytes its pair held.

name: DropResult
doc: What a drop did.

name: live_turn_groups
doc: Which engine ports a live turn serves, as the stale-pair drop wants them.

name: live_kv_protection
doc: Split live KV-protection into (HARD, SOFT) thread_hash sets.

name: dir_accounting_logged
doc: Return ``(total_bytes, bins)`` for ``save_dir``, logging a failed scan at DEBUG.

name: save_declined_by_cap
doc: True when the slot KV save must be declined because the RAM cap holds.

name: drop_stale_pairs_after_save
signature: (host, drop_fn, save_dir, model_tag, thread_hash, port, final_path, n_written, bin_fn)
doc: One pair per thread: the new pair has landed, so the pairs this thread left on other ports go.

name: evict_soft_floor
signature: (surviving, deleted_paths, hard_hashes, soft_hashes, pinned_paths, hash_by_path, total, max_bytes, unlink_pair)
doc: The GC's fallback when a HARD floor holds the directory over its cap.

name: RecheckInputs
doc: What the caller measured for one tag.

name: RecheckDecision
doc: The decision, with the reason attached so a log can say which rule applied.

name: decide_recheck
doc: Say whether to re-ask the second-engine spawn path for this tag.

name: CoResidenceHost
doc: Everything the module touches on the manager. Nothing else may be used.

name: DeclineReason
doc: Why the step-2 spawn path did not add a second engine for a tag.

name: format_step2_decline
doc: The single INFO line for a declined second engine; no trailing newline.

name: format_recheck_action
doc: The single INFO line for a re-check that is about to take a waiting slot; no trailing newline.

name: NoRoomMemo
doc: Key -> expiry time, with a fixed time-to-live and a fixed size bound.

name: run_recheck
doc: Run one re-check pass. Never raises, except for a cancellation.

name: Candidate
doc: One waiting request: its age, source rank (0 staged, 1 inbox), source, slot and owner.

name: inbox_slots
doc: The slots waiting in ``r``'s inbox right now, oldest first.

name: take_from_inbox
doc: Take ``slot`` (matched by identity) out of ``r``'s inbox; None when it is not there.

name: gather_candidates
doc: Every waiting request old enough to count, oldest first, staged before inbox on a tie.

name: pick_candidate
doc: The oldest candidate of the first tag the per-tag decision lets run, or None.

name: RecheckState
doc: When the last attempt ran, and the two bounded memos the re-check uses.

name: Verdict
doc: Admit a further engine on ``card`` / ``split`` (need in MiB), or decline with ``reason``.

name: fit_verdict
doc: The re-check verdict: does one more engine of ``tag`` fit? Caller holds the registry lock.

name: arrival_verdict
doc: The arrival verdict: the tag's own ceiling and the box budget first, then the fit.

name: RecheckGate
doc: Whether a re-check attempt may run now, with the reason attached for a log.

name: recheck_window
doc: Decide whether the box-wide re-check may run an attempt now: debounce only.

name: demand_is_eligible
doc: True when a waiting request has waited long enough to count as starved demand.

name: SiblingLoad
doc: One model already resident on the box, as the caller sees it.

name: retry_read_free_vram
doc: Return the first non-empty per-card free-MiB reading, or an empty list.

name: reserved_loading_mib
doc: Return the VRAM still to be taken by booting siblings on card ``gpu``.

name: fits
doc: Return True when the card has room for ``need_mib`` after reserve and credit.

name: admit
doc: Decide admission from a per-card free-MiB reading.

name: needs_exit_line
doc: False only for MAKE_ROOM, whose death is already logged by the make-room path.

name: format_resident_exit
doc: The one RESIDENT_EXIT line for a death, with no trailing newline.

name: ExitReason
doc: The cause recorded on a resident's exit line.

name: RetentionInputs
doc: Everything the keep-warm decision needs, measured by the caller.

name: RetentionDecision
doc: The keep-warm answer, with the rule that produced it so a log can say why.

name: decide_retention
doc: Apply the rules in order; the first one that matches decides.

name: log_resident_exit
doc: One RESIDENT_EXIT line per resident death. Best-effort: never raises into the death path.

name: resolve_exit_reason
doc: The reason a resident's death is logged under: the one the caller stamped, else a default.

name: hold_warm_window
doc: Keep a finishing co-resident warm for a bounded window.

name: Stop
doc: A gate failed. The run ends here; ``step`` names the gate.

name: Env
doc: The run's view of the outside world.

name: LoadLike
doc: One engine's registry entry: the attributes the load reads.

name: pending_load
doc: The work pending on engine ``r``: riders in flight, plus one for a running turn, plus the inbox depth.

name: stash_identity
doc: Store the identity of the request just bound to resident ``r`` under ``r.resident_key``.

name: identity_for
doc: The stored identity of resident ``r``, or None. A resident with no key reads the entry of its model tag.

name: forget_identity
doc: Drop the identity stored under ``r.resident_key``, always exactly that key: a same-model sibling has its own.

name: ResidentLike
doc: One engine's registry entry: the attributes the module reads.

name: SlotLike
doc: The request just bound to a resident: the attributes the identity is built from.

name: ResidentIdentityHost
doc: The manager, reduced to the four members the module uses.

name: serving_resident
doc: The first resident of the host's snapshot whose ``handle`` is ``handle``, or None.

name: spawn_seq_for_handle
doc: The spawn counter of the resident serving ``handle``.

name: evict_unstarted
doc: Remove one waiting request at the source: flag it, free its claim, drop it from the queues, fail it.

name: notify_client_gone
doc: Tell the system a client has gone: set its event and schedule the eviction of its waiting requests.

name: client_gone
doc: True when the request's client has gone: the slot is already flagged evicted, or its

name: stamp_if_disconnected
doc: Flag the slot evicted when its disconnect event is set, and say whether its client is gone.

name: drop_if_gone
doc: Flag the slot if its client has gone and, if so, fail it once. True iff the client is gone.

name: SlotLike
doc: One waiting request: the attributes the module reads and writes.

name: ResidentLike
doc: One engine's registry entry: the attributes the module reads.

name: QueueLivenessHost
doc: The manager, reduced to the six members the module uses.
